summary.text: Lashrecse D. Aird is a Democratic member of the Virginia Senate, representing District 13, which covers all of Charles City County, Prince George County, Surry County, Sussex County, Hopewell City and Petersburg City, and parts of Dinwiddie County and Henrico County, and has served in the Senate since 2024.
Aird sits on the Senate committees on Local Government; Education and Health; Finance and Appropriations; Transportation; and Rules, and chairs Local Government.

paragraphs.text: Lashrecse D. Aird was born in Buffalo, New York on June 22, 1986, according to the Senate profile.
The profile lists Aird's education as Virginia State University (Bachelor of Arts).
The profile gives Aird's occupation as executive director of the Virginia State University and Richard Bland College Joint School of Professional and Technical Studies.
Lashrecse D. Aird was a member of the House of Delegates from 2016–2022, according to the profile.
Memberships and affiliations listed on the profile include Virginia State Social Action Coordinator for Delta Sigma Theta Sorority, Inc.; Chippenham Johnston-Willis Hospital, Board of Directors.
Listed awards include Woman of the Year by USA Today (2021); University of Virginia's Emerging Leader Award.
